body:
+1 from [Ultralytics](https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics): PyYAML is a base dependency of `ultralytics` and several of our services.

On CPython 3.15.0 final, PyYAML 6.0.3 has no `cp315` wheel, so installers fall back to the sdist. Without libyaml headers on the build machine that produces a pure-Python install (`yaml.__with_libyaml__ == False`), so users silently lose the C loader. Since #971 already brought CI up to 3.15, a release with the `cp315`/`cp315t` wheels would resolve this. Happy to help test a release candidate.

Thank you for maintaining PyYAML!
